description: Example scheduled workflow: every night an agent drafts a digest of the day's notes and saves it to the workspace. Pair with a cron trigger (e.g. '0 22 * * *') via the TriggerStore / Scheduler to run on a schedule.
name: Nightly digest

config.prompt: Write a short nightly digest from today's workspace notes in notes/. Keep it under 200 words with a 'Top items' list.
